item.title: Dousoukai ~Yesterday Once More~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Fairytale, F&C FC01
  • 発売日: 1996-09-12
  • スコア: 7.08/10 (11 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 同窓会 ～Yesterday Once More～
  • 英語名: Dousoukai Yesterday Once More

あらすじ

One day an invitation arrives from a friend who was with you in the tennis club when you were in middle school. It is an invitation to the reunion of the tennis club members. You have one week. You can either go for your first love, or find another love, or become a cupid for others…

item.title: Virtua Call
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Fairytale, F&C FC01
  • 発売日: 1995-02-24
  • スコア: 5.7/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: バーチャコール
  • 英語名: Virtua Call

别名

  • Virtua Call

あらすじ

Videophones are invented. Now there are new opportunities to get to know pretty girls.

[From vndbreview]

While trying to pick up girls, a guy got given an ad for a new video phone service. At home, he calls the number, meeting the virtual girl whom connects him to girls. He talk with and get to know the girls on phone, then date them. If he is successful with the 10 or so girls, he might get a surprise and find out what virtual is.
